about: Bare-dice decisions in AI code (tools/lint-reasons.mjs, W1-2, R1, D-069): a roll of A.chance or rng.chance that decides a war, a peace, a faction, a revolt, an appointment, an alliance, a claim or a succession without A.WHY.decide. The count may only fall: tools/check.mjs fails when it rises. Lower it with node tools/lint-reasons.mjs --write when a decision is routed through A.WHY; never raise it without a line in docs/DECISIONS.md. W1-2 set it: 72 before (2d7de66), 66 once the war council, DV.tryWar and the faction choices went through A.WHY. docs/design/r1-audit.md lists the rest.
